description_en: Updates the information about a specified identity provider for role-based single sign-on (SSO)
description_zh: 修改指定的角色SSO身份提供商信息
name: UpdateSAMLProvider

parameters.help_en: The name of the identity provider to modify
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的身份提供商名称
parameters.name: saml_provider_name

parameters.help_en:
The new description.

Specify at least one of the `NewDescription` and `NewEncodedSAMLMetadataDocument` parameters
parameters.help_zh:
新的备注。

`NewDescription`与`NewEncodedSAMLMetadataDocument`参数必须至少填写一个
parameters.name: new_description

parameters.help_en:
The new metadata file.

Specify at least one of the `NewDescription` and `NewEncodedSAMLMetadataDocument` parameters
parameters.help_zh:
新的元数据文档。
`NewDescription`与`NewEncodedSAMLMetadataDocument`参数必须至少填写一个
parameters.name: new_encoded_saml_metadata_document

parameters.help_en:
The signature algorithm supported by the Alibaba Cloud service provider (SP). Valid values:

rsa-sha256

rsa-sha1
parameters.help_zh:
阿里云SP支持的签名算法。取值：

rsa-sha256
rsa-sha1
parameters.name: authn_sign_algo

SAMLProvider.description_en: The information about the identity provider

Arn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the identity provider

The signature algorithm supported by the Alibaba Cloud SP. Valid values:

rsa-sha256

rsa-sha1
AuthnSignAlgo.description_zh:
阿里云SP支持的签名算法。取值：

rsa-sha256
rsa-sha1

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the identity provider was created. The time is in UTC
CreateDate.description_zh: 身份提供商的创建时间（UTC时间）

SAMLProviderName.description_en: The name of the identity provider

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the identity provider was last updated. The time is in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)
UpdateDate.description_zh: 身份提供商的修改时间（UTC时间）
